checks.detail: PackageManager accepted the final AOSP-built APK in a fresh isolated AVD
Opened using DPAD_CENTER on Home install tile
HTTP200 from selected private emulator interface
Pairing screen closed and listening socket absent
Back returned to Home without drawer
No Vortex fatal exception in cleared smoke log
No listener for pairing port in either /proc/net/tcp or /proc/net/tcp6 after Back

limits: Smoke test of an AOSP-built APK on the installed Android 7.1.1 API25 x86 emulator image; not a built Android ROM.
No Rockchip ARM drivers, physical TV Box, firmware boot or storage writes were exercised.
HTTP was requested from within the emulator to its private interface; a real phone/LAN and USB media were not tested.
No full PackageInstaller upload/install regression or power privileges were tested in this smoke run.
harness_note: Initial harness assumed focus before the first D-pad event. The fresh AVD started in touch mode; evidence of that harness-only failure is preserved under harness-first-attempt. No app change was needed.

emulator_shutdown.note: Requested adb emu kill terminates this emulator with SIGUSR1; not an observed app crash.
